Financial Expertise: Demonstrated proficiency in budgeting, accounting, and the use of cost control systems such as Oracle, Tririga, or Google Live Sheets. Strong Leadership: Proven ability to influence stakeholders through logical arguments, think creatively, and operate with substantial independence. Education: A Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Finance, Business, or a related field; professional certifications like PMP or P.E. are industry-standard and highly desirable. What We Offer (Benefits) Total Rewards: Competitive compensation and benefits packages aligned with your experience level. review_candidates.location: Ras Al Khaimah, Ras al-Khaimah, United Arab Emirates
review_candidates.description: Company Description Hira Industries LLC is part of Hira Group, a globally trusted manufacturer serving the building and construction industry since 1980. Founded in Dubai, UAE, the group provides reliable building solutions across HVAC systems, thermal insulation foams, rubber products, adhesive tapes, and engineered building solutions. Its products support applications in HVAC, MEP, civil construction, infrastructure, commercial, residential, industrial, and specialized projects. Hira Group employs over 2,000 professionals and operates offices and manufacturing facilities across the Middle East, India, Southeast Asia, Vietnam, Australia, New Zealand, Africa, and the Americas. The company combines manufacturing expertise with strong market insight to deliver consistent quality, technical reliability, and dependable project support for projects worldwide. Key Responsibilities Manage end-to-end procurement for maintenance, facilities, general materials and services . Handle procurement of AMC and annual service contracts for facilities, equipment and building services. Source and manage vendors for: HVAC and air-conditioning maintenance Electrical maintenance Plumbing Civil maintenance MEP services Fire & safety systems Pest control Cleaning services Landscaping Security services Waste management Other facility-related services Procure maintenance spare parts, tools, consumables, electrical items, mechanical items and MRO materials . Obtain RFQs, compare quotations and prepare commercial comparison sheets . Negotiate with suppliers on pricing, payment terms, delivery timelines and service agreements . Prepare and process Purchase Orders (POs) and ensure timely delivery. Coordinate with Maintenance, Facilities, Administration, HR, Finance, IT, Logistics and other departments to understand requirements. Manage AMC renewals , negotiate commercial terms and ensure continuity of critical services. Maintain an updated database of approved suppliers and service providers. Evaluate vendor performance based on cost, quality, service and delivery . Follow up with vendors for delayed materials, services, repairs and maintenance activities. Support cost-saving initiatives through vendor negotiation, alternative sourcing and competitive quotations . Monitor open POs, pending deliveries and outstanding procurement requirements. Coordinate with Finance regarding GRN, invoices and payment issues . Ensure procurement activities comply with company policies and approval procedures. Maintain proper procurement documentation for audit purposes. Support budget planning and cost control for maintenance and facilities procurement . SAP / ERP Responsibilities Create and process Purchase Requisitions and Purchase Orders in SAP MM . Maintain accurate procurement and vendor information. Track PO, GRN and invoice status. Monitor open POs and pending deliveries. Generate procurement reports and maintain accurate system records. Requirements Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain, Procurement, Business Administration or a related field . 4+ years of procurement experience , preferably in manufacturing, industrial, facilities or maintenance environments. Strong hands-on experience in Facilities & Maintenance Procurement . Experience handling AMC / annual maintenance contracts and service contracts . Good knowledge of MEP, maintenance spare parts and MRO materials . Experience with RFQs, quotation comparison, vendor evaluation and negotiations. SAP MM experience is highly preferred. Good knowledge of UAE suppliers and local market. Strong Excel and MS Office skills. Good communication, negotiation and vendor-management skills. UAE procurement experience is preferred. Candidates with manufacturing/factory procurement experience will be strongly preferred. Preferred Candidate Profile: Procurement professionals who have worked with manufacturing companies, factories, FM companies, property management companies or industrial facilities , particularly those handling AMC contracts + maintenance materials + facilities procurement .

review_candidates.title: PMO en appui aux Chefs de Projet Système Ferroviaire - JUNIOR
review_candidates.description: Description De L'employeur A u sein du groupe SNCF, SNCF Réseau exerce la fonction de gestionnaire d'infrastructure en toute indépendance en garantissant une concurrence loyale et un accès équitable au réseau ferré national. Les salariés de SNCF Réseau s'engagent à respecter un code de bonne conduite afin d'assurer une stricte confidentialité des informations sensibles et prévenir toute influence d'autres entités du groupe SNCF sur l'attribution des sillons et la tarification des infrastructures. Lien vers Le code de bonne conduite de SNCF Réseau | SNCF Réseau Vous êtes passionné(e) par les systèmes informatiques complexes appliqués au domaine ferroviaire ? Rejoignez la division des Projets Intégration Système Haute Performance au sein de l'Agence Projet IP3M. Cette entité pilote des projets stratégiques de modernisation de la signalisation ferroviaire en s'appuyant sur de nouvelles générations de systèmes de contrôle-commande, d'enclenchements, de détection des circulations et de technologies ETCS. Ces projets visent à améliorer la performance de l'exploitation ferroviaire tout en optimisant les coûts de déploiement et de maintenance. Dans un environnement technique exigeant et multi-acteurs, vous contribuerez à la coordination des interfaces entre les différents projets et parties prenantes afin de garantir la réussite des opérations dans le respect des objectifs de qualité, de délais et de performance. Description Du Poste Votre mission Au sein des équipes projets ferroviaires, vous accompagnez les Chefs de Projet Système dans le pilotage, l'ordonnancement et la coordination des activités nécessaires à la réussite des projets. En appui des projets Système Haute Performance, vous contribuez à garantir la cohérence des actions menées, le respect des jalons et la maîtrise des engagements en matière de délais, de qualité et de coordination. Véritable interface entre les différents acteurs du projet, vous assurez la consolidation des données de pilotage, le suivi des plannings et la remontée des risques afin de sécuriser l'avancement des opérations. Vos principales responsabilités En tant que PMO Projets Système Ferroviaire, vous êtes notamment chargé(e) de : Construire, consolider et maintenir les plannings projets sous MS Project, COPLANN ou tout autre outil équivalent. Assurer le suivi des activités de production, d'essais, de déploiement et de mise en service des systèmes ferroviaires. Collecter, analyser et consolider les données d'avancement auprès des différents contributeurs. Garantir la cohérence des jalons, des échéances et des chemins critiques du projet. Suivre les interfaces entre les différentes parties prenantes : maîtrise d'ouvrage, maîtrise d'oeuvre, industriels, partenaires et équipes terrain. Identifier les dérives planning, anticiper les points de blocage et proposer des actions correctives. Mettre à jour les registres de risques, alertes, points sensibles et plans d'actions. Élaborer et suivre les indicateurs de pilotage (avancement, délais, risques, actions). Préparer les supports de reporting et contribuer à l'animation des instances de gouvernance projet. Participer à la préparation des phases d'essais, de déploiement et de mise en service. Assurer une communication fluide entre l'ensemble des acteurs afin de favoriser la circulation de l'information et la coordination des activités. Votre environnement de travail Vous intervenez au coeur de projets ferroviaires à forte dimension technique et transverse. Vous travaillez en étroite collaboration avec les chefs de projet, les équipes d'ingénierie, les industriels et les équipes opérationnelles présentes sur les sites de déploiement. Des déplacements ponctuels sur les sites de projet peuvent être nécessaires afin d'assurer un suivi opérationnel au plus près des équipes et des activités de terrain. Profil recherché Rejoignez nous si vous êtes titulaire d'une formation de niveau Bac+5 en gestion de projet, assistance technique, transport, travaux ou dans un domaine équivalent. Vous justifiez d'une expérience en pilotage opérationnel, coordination de projet ou planification. Une connaissance de l'environnement ferroviaire ainsi qu'une expérience sur des projets complexes impliquant de multiples acteurs constituent des atouts appréciés. Compétences techniques Maîtrise des outils de planification et de suivi tels que MS Project, COPLANN, Excel et les outils collaboratifs. Compétences en suivi des coûts, délais, risques et coordination opérationnelle. Capacité à animer des réunions, rédiger des comptes rendus et assurer le suivi des plans d'actions. Aptitude à piloter simultanément plusieurs sujets dans un environnement complexe. Compétences comportementales Sens de l'organisation et rigueur. Autonomie et réactivité. Aisance relationnelle et sens du travail en équipe. Capacité d'analyse et esprit de synthèse. Sens des priorités et qualité de communication. Principales améliorations apportées Clarté : simplification des formulations et suppression des répétitions. Dynamisme : utilisation de verbes d'action et d'une structure orientée missions. Lisibilité : segmentation en rubriques RH classiques avec des listes à puces. Attractivité : valorisation des enjeux et du contexte projet tout en conservant fidèlement le contenu initial.

Akili continually explores emerging technologies to expand its impact and improve outcomes for people living with cognitive challenges. The team is driven by a mission to change the status quo in medicine and ignite new hope for patients and families worldwide. Day-to-day responsibilities include defining business objectives, setting performance goals, and making key decisions on product, partnerships, and investments. The Owner leads and mentors cross-functional teams, fostering a culture of innovation, accountability, and collaboration while ensuring alignment with Akili’s global mission in digital medicine. This role involves building and maintaining relationships with clinical partners, technology vendors, regulators, and other stakeholders to support growth and compliance. The Owner also monitors market trends, evaluates new opportunities, manages budgets, and ensures that operations meet legal, ethical, and quality standards. Demonstrated capacity to thrive in a fast-paced, mission-driven environment and to drive change and innovation. Bachelor’s degree in business, healthcare administration, technology, or a related field; advanced degree is preferred.

Tier 1: Other UNDP/UNCDF/UNV staff holding permanent (PA) and fixed-term (FTA) appointments Tier 2: UNDP/UNCDF/UNV staff holding temporary appointments (TA), personnel on regular PSA contracts, and Expert and Specialist UN Volunteers Tier 3 or no tier indicated: All other contract types from UNDP/UNCDF/UNV and other agencies, and other external candidates Please make note of the Tier(s) indicated in the vacancy title, if any, and ensure that you satisfy the eligibility to apply. Background You are invited to join a team of dedicated development professionals whose primary role is to support the Philippines to achieve the 2030 Agenda. As part of the UNDP team your focus will be to work with multiple stakeholders to find the country specific solutions that lead to resilience to crises, and to ensure no one is left behind - and we reach those furthest behind first. In Mindanao, UNDP has played a critical role in supporting various peace processes, including technical and operational assistance during the peace negotiations as well as in the implementation of peace agreements towards realizing peace dividends for communities in conflict-affected areas. This accompaniment process has included substantive technical and operational support for conflict-prevention, governance and peacebuilding. Specifically, the Peacebuilding Cluster has implemented technical and operational support for capacity-strengthening on conflict-sensitivity and peace-promotion among regional government institutions; community resilience and socio-economic empowerment assistance for communities most affected by armed conflict; and support for peace process mechanisms, including on key components of the Normalization process. In addition, projects under the Cluster also focus on strengthening meaningful participation and empowerment of sectoral groups (women, youth, Indigenous Peoples, and internally displaced persons) through the mainstreaming and operationalization of the Women, Peace and Security and Youth, Peace and Security agenda. To support results-based monitoring and evaluation for Peacebuilding projects, UNDP is seeking a Monitoring and Evaluation Associate who is willing to be based in Cotabato City, and who will support the Project Manager in establishing and operationalizing the Monitoring, Evaluation, Accountability and Learning system of Peacebuilding projects, including (1) Programme on Stabilization, Peacebuilding and Resilience Phase 2, (2) Joint Programme on Empowering Women for Sustainable Peace, and (3) Preventing Violent Extremism. The M&E Associate will work closely with local authorities, civil society organizations, UN agencies, and various stakeholders to ensure a coordinated approach to governance, stabilization and resilience, and normalization initiatives under the Project. The M&E Associate will support MEAL initiatives ensuring effective monitoring and reporting of key outputs and results from the Project. The M&E Associate will also help operationalize and enhance feedback and response mechanisms for the Project, ensuring that appropriate, timely and effective action and referral are facilitated in response to feedback or grievances received from partners and stakeholders. Together with project team members and partners, the M&E Associate will provide support for quality assurance processes relative to the established progress on indicators, tracking achievements, challenges encountered and identifying lessons learned. In doing so, s/he will provide information that will support the Project Board and the Project Staff in decision making in line with the overall strategic objectives of the Project. S/he will also carry out capacity building and mentoring of Project staff and partners in relation to the Project’s MEAL system. Duties And Responsibilities Programme Management Support: Support planning, design and management of the Peacebuilding Projects; Provide analysis and written outputs on the work of the Project, emerging issues and their impact for the implementation of the governance, conflict prevention, stabilization and normalization initiatives under the Project; Supports the formulation, revision, and implementation of the Annual Work Plan; Support partnership with think tanks, academic and research institutions and lead on specified action research activities that will contribute to the implementation of the Project; Support the Project team in the preparation of key events on Project governance, such as Project Board meetings, donor visits to the project sites, and verification and monitoring missions; Support the Project team in drafting and revising technical reports and donor reports. Monitoring, Evaluation And Reporting Ensure effective monitoring and evaluation of the Project, including through recommending improvement of results frameworks to align to the UNDP CPD and SP; Maintain and update the project’s monitoring and evaluation plan, based on the Project document, specifically in terms of the outputs, outcomes and indicators, including the following: Identifying sources of data and collection methods (quantitative and qualitative); Identifying criteria and assessment process to examine Project benefits and sustainability; Developing M&E tools for Project activities and outputs aligned with the identified indicators; Facilitating training and guidance for Project staff and partners regarding the application of M&E tools as well as data collection and analysis procedures; Regular review and updating of the M&E plan, including maintaining of data repository for the Project; Implement MEAL activities included in the Annual Work Plan, with particular focus on results and impacts, through the following processes: Adopting a results-based approach for monitoring and evaluation, emphasizing results and impact; Preparing consolidated progress reports to inform Project management through identification of challenges and bottlenecks in Project implementation and recommended solutions; Facilitating field visits to support M&E, including gathering of change stories; Co-designing and supporting evaluation mission, data quality assessments and lessons learning workshops; Establish and operationalize Feedback and Response Mechanisms for the Project, including regular analysis of feedback received and responses provided to affected partners and stakeholders; Support regular monitoring of risks and application of social and environmental safeguards and other risk management measures, including updating of Project risk logs. Prepare and consolidate Project reports (monthly, quarterly, annual) and facilitate regular assessment of Project implementation relative to criteria of relevance, effectiveness, efficiency, impact and sustainability of the Project, including through regular reviews; Organize and support monitoring and evaluation missions involving UNDP, the Philippine Government, the BARMM Government, and donor delegates to visit field sites and activities on the ground. Support Knowledge Management Identify and consolidate lessons learned and recommendations to be integrated into UNDP’s broader knowledge management efforts; Contribute to relevant knowledge networks and communities of practice, with a view to facilitating innovation and knowledge sharing mechanisms; Liaise with the Communications Team to formulate outreach, communication and reporting materials and packages to support resource mobilization and general communication efforts including visibility events to promote Project achievements to the relevant stakeholders. The incumbent will also perform other duties and responsibilities within their functional profile as deemed necessary for the efficient functioning of the Office and the Organization. Institutional Arrangement Under the overall guidance and direct supervision of the Project Manager, the M&E Associate will be tasked to deliver distinct outputs of the project, to ensure quality implementation. S/he will work with key partners and stakeholders, to effectively deliver M&E outputs of the project, to support quality Project implementation towards achievement of delivery targets. Competencies Core Competencies Achieve Results: Level 1: Plans and monitors own work, pays attention to details, delivers quality work by deadline Think Innovatively: Level 1: Open to creative ideas/known risks, is pragmatic problem solver, makes improvements Learn Continuously: Level 1: Open minded and curious, shares knowledge, learns from mistakes, asks for feedback Adapt with Agility: Level 1: Adapts to change, constructively handles ambiguity/uncertainty, is flexible Act with Determination: Level 1: Shows drive and motivation, able to deliver calmly in face of adversity, confident Engage and Partner: Level 1: Demonstrates compassion/understanding towards others, forms positive relationships Enable Diversity and Inclusion: Level 1: Appreciate/respect differences, aware of unconscious bias, confront discrimination Cross-Functional & Technical Competencies Business Management: Partnerships Management: Build and maintain partnerships with wide networks of stakeholders, Governments, civil society and private sector partners, experts and others in line with UNDP strategy and policies Business management: Monitoring and Evaluation: Ability to systematically monitor results of strategies, programmes, and activities with a view to make sure that they are being implemented effectively; Ability to provide managers and key stakeholders with regular feedback and reporting on the consistency or discrepancy between planned activities and programme management and results. Ability to make independent judgment of the management and results of strategies, programmes and activities based on set criteria and benchmark, keeping in mind the needs and concerns of client, current and upcoming. Knowledge and understanding of monitoring and evaluation frameworks, concepts, methodologies, systems, processes, and tools. Ability to make an independent judgement based on set criteria and benchmarks. Ability to anticipate client's upcoming needs and concerns. Business Direction & Strategy : Futures & foresight: Ability to look at information from the past and present, identify patterns and trends and use them to inform decision making with a long-term view. Being sensitive and able to scan horizons and pick up weak signals of change, explore their potential implications and assess their impact and urgency. Using creativity and imagination to communicate insights in compelling and engaging ways to challenge current mental models; ability to develop scenarios, speculative designs to present future visions or by making it experiential. Being able to facilitate debate and discussion about possible futures; help people to feel comfortable with the discomfort of uncertainty. Audit & Investigation – General: Financial and Managerial Accounting and Finance key concepts: Key concepts and principles of financial accounting, interpret financial analysis, managerial accounting, etc. Digital & Innovation: Collective intelligence design: Ability to design, lead or manage processes that help a collective to become smarter together by bringing together diverse groups of people, data, and technology. Ability to define and articulate why and how collective intelligence can add value to development programming understanding problems; finding solutions; decision making and mobilizing action; monitoring progress in real time, learning and adapting) Being able to integrate different types of data (real-time, ‘ground- truth’ and novel data) to unlock fresh insights. Understand guidelines and principles around data privacy, ethics and protection. Increase diversity of inputs – and look beyond the 'usual suspects', ability to navigate and manage a variety of actors, appreciate the diversity in perspectives, opinions, expertise. Ability to facilitate platforms or sessions where people can contribute by providing their views and ideas independently and freely. Being people-centered: ensure people understand and can determine how their data is used. Feed back inputs and insights to empower people, don't extract data. Digital : Data literacy: Understand the potential as well as the limitations of using data driven innovation. Ability to use a mix of data sources (quantitative, qualitative or real-time techniques) to develop understanding, identify patterns to inform decision making or identify opportunities for further exploration Education Required Skills and Experience Secondary Education is required. or University or college degree (bachelor’s degree) in Economics, Statistics, Data Science, Development Studies, Business Administration will be given due consideration, but it is not a requirement. Experience Minimum of seven (7) years (with secondary education) or four (4) years (with bachelor’s degree) of professional experience in monitoring & evaluation support for peacebuilding and/or development projects or programs. review_candidates.description: Company Description The Trans-Continental M&A division is an interim part of AMWORLD Group of Enterprises, operating across major markets including North America, Europe, APAC, and MENA. Recognized as the Best Global M&A Advisory Firm–India by leading London publications in 2018 and 2019, the firm specializes in financial and strategic advisory services for growing companies through a strategic partnership model. AMWORLD focuses on raising capital for public and private companies via acquisitions, private placements, and reverse mergers, as well as trans-continental buy-side and sell-side transaction advisory. The firm supports clients in building global business models through direct distribution networks, franchise development, and strategic collaborations. Its sector focus includes automotive ancillaries, aerospace, healthcare and pharma, information and technology, renewable energy, and real estate and hospitality. Role Description This is a full-time remote role for a Mergers and Acquisitions Consultant. The consultant will advise clients on buy-side and sell-side transactions, including market research, target identification, valuation support, and deal structuring. Daily activities include conducting financial and commercial due diligence, preparing transaction documents and presentations, and supporting negotiations with investors, acquirers, and strategic partners. The role involves collaborating with cross-border teams, coordinating with legal, tax, and finance advisors, and contributing to corporate finance and strategic growth initiatives across target sectors. The consultant will also help maintain client relationships, track deal pipelines, and provide insights on market trends and regulatory developments. Qualifications Strong analytical skills to evaluate companies, markets, and transaction structures. Consulting experience in M&A, corporate advisory, or strategy roles. Finance skills, including valuation, financial modelling, and capital markets understanding. Due diligence expertise covering financial, commercial, and operational aspects of transactions. Accounting knowledge to interpret financial statements and assess financial performance. Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including client-facing presentations. Ability to work independently in a remote, cross-border environment and manage multiple projects. Bachelor’s or master’s degree in finance, accounting, business, economics, or a related field; professional certifications (e.g., CFA, CA, CPA, MBA) are an advantage. Prior experience in investment banking, corporate finance, private equity, or transaction advisory is highly beneficial. Familiarity with the firm’s focus sectors (e.g., automotive ancillaries, aerospace, healthcare, IT, renewable energy, real estate) is a plus.

Elle intervient sur l'ensemble du cycle de vie des infrastructures, de la maîtrise d'ouvrage à l'exploitation, afin d'accompagner la transition numérique de l'entreprise. Au sein de l'Agence Réseaux Télécoms d'Exploitation des Services (ARTES), les équipes assurent la gestion des incidents sur les installations de télécommunications, la mise en service des nouveaux équipements supervisés et la réalisation des opérations de maintenance préventive et corrective à distance. Elles contribuent également à la disponibilité et à la performance des services essentiels aux activités ferroviaires Description Du Poste En tant qu' Ingénieur ou Ingénieure support télécoms GSM-R, vous... Assurez le traitement des incidents complexes et le support de niveau 2 en lien avec le centre de supervision, les équipes d'ingénierie et les fournisseurs lorsque nécessaire. Analysez les causes des dysfonctionnements, évaluez leurs impacts sur le service et proposez des solutions correctives ou des mesures de contournement adaptées. Suivez les performances des services reposant sur les infrastructures GSM-R et/ou ERTMS. Collaborez avec les unités d'assistance en charge de la téléphonie ferroviaire pour la gestion des réclamations et des évolutions du réseau. Prenez part à la démarche d'amélioration continue en contribuant notamment à l'automatisation des tâches à faible valeur ajoutée. Connaissance de l'approche ITIL appréciée. Excellentes capacités d'analyse et de synthèse. Rigueur et sens de l'organisation. Aisance rédactionnelle et capacité à formaliser des procédures ou analyses techniques. Bon relationnel et goût du travail en équipe. Capacité à appréhender et conceptualiser des problématiques complexes. Faculté d'adaptation et réactivité face aux situations techniques. Force de proposition et proactivité dans l'amélioration des pratiques et des processus.

review_candidates.title: General Manager - The Ritz-Carlton Marrakesh
review_candidates.description: Additional Information Job Number 26115399 Job Category Property Leadership Location Douar Al Arabe, Marrakech, Morocco, Morocco,VIEW ON MAP Schedule Full Time Located Remotely? N Position Type Management General Manager - The Ritz-Carlton Marrakesh Anticipated opening: 2027 At more than a century old, The Ritz-Carlton continues to set the standard in luxury hospitality, guided by a simple but powerful promise: Ladies and Gentlemen serving Ladies and Gentlemen. In 2027, that legacy will take on a distinctive new expression with the anticipated opening of The Ritz-Carlton, Marrakech—an exceptional resort and residential destination set amid the natural beauty, culture and energy of Morocco. The opportunity As General Manager, you will shape the hotel from its foundations: building the leadership team, establishing the culture, preparing the operation and bringing The Ritz-Carlton service philosophy to life in a way that is both globally recognisable and authentically connected to Marrakech. Working in close partnership with ownership and Marriott International’s regional leadership, you will provide strategic direction across the hotel, residences and wider resort experience. You will create a commercially successful operation while ensuring that every decision reflects the quality, craftsmanship and highly personalised service expected of The Ritz-Carlton. The role requires a leader who can move confidently between vision and execution—someone equally comfortable inspiring future Ladies and Gentlemen, engaging with ownership, influencing commercial strategy and attending to the smallest detail of the guest experience. The role You will: Lead all aspects of the pre-opening journey, from critical-path planning and recruitment to operational readiness and launch. Recruit, develop and inspire a world-class Executive Committee and hotel team. Establish a culture grounded in The Ritz-Carlton Gold Standards and the traditions of genuine Moroccan hospitality. Build a trusted, transparent and commercially focused relationship with ownership. Position the resort successfully within Marrakech’s competitive international luxury market. Develop strategies to attract high-value leisure, residential and destination guests from key international feeder markets. Lead the development of distinctive dining, wellness, cultural and resort experiences that create a genuine sense of place. Ensure operational excellence across the hotel, villas, residences and shared resort environment. Establish robust financial, commercial and operational disciplines before opening. Build meaningful relationships within Marrakech and the wider Moroccan tourism, cultural and business communities. Champion talent development, inclusion and the creation of long-term career opportunities for local talent. Deliver an opening that creates both immediate impact and a sustainable platform for long-term performance. What You Will Bring You will be an accomplished luxury hospitality leader with the presence, judgement and energy required to open a landmark destination. Your experience will ideally include: A successful track record as General Manager of a recognised luxury hotel or resort. Significant pre-opening, repositioning or major transformation experience. Experience leading a complex resort operation incorporating villas, residences or mixed-use elements. Strong owner-management capability, supported by transparent communication and sound commercial judgement. Demonstrable success in luxury positioning, revenue growth, profitability and market activation. A sophisticated understanding of the international luxury traveller and the ability to develop multiple feeder markets. Strong expertise across rooms, food and beverage, wellness and destination-led guest experiences. The ability to build a senior leadership team and create an engaged, high-performing culture from the ground up. Experience operating in Morocco, North Africa, the Middle East, Southern Europe or another culturally rich resort market would be advantageous. Fluency in English; French and/or Arabic would be highly advantageous. Why join us? The Ritz-Carlton, Marrakech offers the opportunity to create something truly distinctive: a resort shaped by one of the world’s great luxury brands, the spirit of Marrakech and an extraordinary natural and cultural setting. You will join Marriott International at a pivotal moment in the continued growth of its luxury portfolio across Europe, the Middle East and Africa, with the platform, expertise and global reach to build an enduring destination. This is more than an opening. It is an opportunity to establish a legacy. If you have the experience, imagination and leadership presence to bring this vision to life, we would be delighted to hear from you. At Marriott International, we are dedicated to being an equal opportunity employer, welcoming all and providing access to opportunity. We actively foster an environment where the unique backgrounds of our associates are valued and celebrated. Our greatest strength lies in the rich blend of culture, talent, and experiences of our associates. We are committed to non-discrimination on any protected basis, including disability, veteran status, or other basis protected by applicable law. At more than 100 award-winning properties worldwide, The Ritz-Carlton Ladies and Gentlemen create experiences so exceptional that long after a guest stays with us, the experience stays with them. Attracting the world’s top hospitality professionals who curate lifelong memories, we believe that everyone succeeds when they are empowered to be creative, thoughtful and compassionate. Every day, we set the standard for rare and special luxury service the world over and pride ourselves on delivering excellence in the care and comfort of our guests. Your role will be to ensure that the “Gold Standards” of The Ritz-Carlton are delivered graciously and thoughtfully every day. The Gold Standards are the foundation of The Ritz-Carlton and are what guides us each day to be better than the next. It is this foundation and our belief that our culture drives success by which The Ritz Carlton has earned the reputation as a global brand leader in luxury hospitality. As part of our team, you will learn and exemplify the Gold Standards, such as our Employee Promise, Credo and our Service Values. And our promise to you is that we offer the chance to be proud of the work you do and who you work with. In joining The Ritz-Carlton, you join a portfolio of brands with Marriott International. Be where you can do your best work, begin your purpose, belong to an amazing global team, and become the best version of you.
